items.title_zh: API Evangelist 对 BrainCo 公开 API 接口的第三方档案
items.title_en: API Evangelist Profile of BrainCo's Public API Surface
bullets_zh: API Evangelist于2026年9月20日发布BrainCo公开API接口的GitHub档案。
BrainCo被描述为哈佛创新实验室背景公司，开发非侵入式BCI硬件与开发者SDK。
该档案帮助开发者跟踪其消费级/科研级API生态。
bullets_en: API Evangelist published a GitHub profile of BrainCo's public API surface on 2026-09-20.
BrainCo is described as a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded company building non-invasive BCI hardware and developer SDKs.
The profile helps developers track the company's consumer and research API ecosystem.
items.brief: 第三方档案梳理BrainCo非侵入式BCI硬件与SDK公开API，便于开发者跟踪。
items.brief_en: Third-party GitHub profile of BrainCo's public API surface for non-invasive BCI hardware and developer SDKs.
items.raw_excerpt: BrainCo — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist. BrainCo is a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded neurotechnology company building non-invasive brain-computer interface (BCI) hardware and the developer SDKs that surround it. Its consumer and research line centers on wearable EEG headbands - Focus, Focus1 and FocusCal

items.title_en: ADS1299 Core SDK for Open EEG/BCI Ecosystem
bullets_zh: 开放SDK面向ADS1299的8–64通道EEG/BCI系统。
包含MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA参考包与Verilog RTL。
支持PC/移动/Linux集成及Python/MATLAB/R分析。
bullets_en: Open SDK targets ADS1299-based 8–64 channel EEG/BCI systems.
Includes MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA reference packages and Verilog RTL.
Supports PC/mobile/Linux integration plus Python/MATLAB/R analysis.
items.brief: 提供ADS1299 EEG硬件、固件与分析工具链，降低非侵入式BCI开发门槛。
items.brief_en: Provides ADS1299 EEG hardware, firmware and analysis toolchains to lower non-invasive BCI development barriers.
items.raw_excerpt: Building the world’s largest and most comprehensive open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem — 8–64CH hardware, 200 MCU/SoC/DSP & FPGA target/reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, Python/MATLAB/R EEG analysis, BCI workflows, validation, education and research.

bullets_zh: 使用EEG中的稳态视觉诱发电位。
实现基本需求的实时选择以提供辅助。
面向无障碍场景的非侵入式BCI应用。
bullets_en: Uses steady-state visual evoked potentials from EEG signals.
Enables real-time selection of basic needs for assistance.
Targets non-invasive BCI applications in accessibility.
items.brief: 基于SSVEP的EEG辅助系统，可实时选择基本需求。
items.brief_en: An assistive SSVEP-based EEG BCI for real-time selection of basic needs.
items.raw_excerpt: MindAid Assistive SSVEP BCI. Assistive SSVEP-based Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) for real-time selection of basic needs through EEG signals.

items.title_zh: SOFA-source：自动选择BCI运行参数的模型项目
items.title_en: SOFA-source: Automatic BCI Parameter Selection Model
bullets_zh: GitHub仓库SOFA-source于2026-09-21发布。
它提出一种模型，通过自动选择最适合每次运行的参数来改进脑机接口。
其意义在于BCI性能常依赖逐次运行参数调优。
bullets_en: GitHub repository SOFA-source was published on 2026-09-21.
It presents a model aimed at improving brain-computer interfaces by automatically selecting parameters best suited to each run.
This matters because BCI performance often depends on run-specific parameter tuning.
items.brief: 开源项目，自动选择BCI运行参数以提升非侵入式脑机接口性能。
items.brief_en: Open-source project that auto-selects BCI run parameters to improve non-invasive brain-computer interfaces.
items.raw_excerpt: SOFA, a model aimed at improving brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) by automatically selecting parameters best suited to each run.

它提供Python实现的BCI拼写器。
它适合学习或快速搭建非侵入式拼写型BCI。
bullets_en: GitHub repository pyspeller was published on 2026-09-21.
It provides a Python implementation of a BCI speller.
This is useful for learning or prototyping non-invasive spelling-based BCIs.
items.brief: Python BCI拼写器开源项目，适合学习和搭建非侵入式拼写交互。
items.brief_en: Open-source Python BCI speller for learning and building non-invasive spelling interfaces.

items.title_zh: neurorvq-rs：纯Rust的NeuroRVQ推理与生理信号分词项目
items.title_en: neurorvq-rs: Pure-Rust NeuroRVQ Inference for EEG/ECG/EMG Tokenization
bullets_zh: GitHub仓库neurorvq-rs于2026-09-21发布。
它构建纯Rust的NeuroRVQ推理，使用Burn 0.20对EEG、ECG和EMG信号进行分词。
零Python依赖使其适合轻量级非侵入式信号处理流程。
bullets_en: GitHub repository neurorvq-rs was published on 2026-09-21.
It builds pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference to tokenize EEG, ECG, and EMG signals using Burn 0.20.
Zero Python dependencies make it useful for lightweight non-invasive signal pipelines.
items.brief: 纯Rust的NeuroRVQ推理项目，轻量处理EEG等生理信号。
items.brief_en: Pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference project for lightweight tokenization of EEG and other physiological signals.
items.raw_excerpt: Build pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference to tokenize EEG, ECG, and EMG signals with Burn 0.20 and zero Python dependencies

items.title_zh: FII BCI语料库脑电预处理脚本
items.title_en: EEG Preprocessing Script for FII BCI Corpus
bullets_zh: GitHub代码库提供一套完整的脑电数据Python预处理脚本。
该脚本面向从FII BCI语料库获取的数据，这是一个非侵入式脑电数据集。
它可帮助研究者复现或扩展基于脑电的BCI分析。
bullets_en: GitHub repository provides a complete Python preprocessing script for EEG data.
The script targets data retrieved from the FII BCI Corpus, a non-invasive EEG dataset.
It can help researchers reproduce or extend EEG-based BCI analyses.
